name: Paralegal
description: Supports the Legal & Corporate Governance value stream by managing board meeting planning, entity licensing, and regulatory filings. Maintains legal records retention, tracks board action items and director education, routes contracts through delegation-of-authority approvals, and handles regulatory correspondence, supporting governance policy management and corporate governance annual disclosures.

name: Payroll Specialist
description: Administers benefits and payroll operations within the Human Resources & Talent value stream, including open enrollment, leave management, and retirement program processing. Submits enrollment files to carriers, resolves post-enrollment discrepancies, processes retirement distributions, and monitors workplace accommodations, working in the HRIS to keep records accurate and compliant.

name: Penetration Tester
description: Performs offensive security testing and hardening across the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream, driving vulnerability risk prioritization and patch remediation tracking. Strengthens container security through image signing and verification, tunes web application firewall coverage, audits privileged activity, and supports data security controls including encryption key lifecycle management.

name: People Analytics / HR Operations Manager
description: Leads HR operations and analytics within the Human Resources & Talent value stream, with supporting work across the PMO, Data & AI, and Risk & Compliance. Coordinates mandatory training compliance, licensing records, coaching programs, and stakeholder engagement, and supports governance activities such as AI policy approval and go-live readiness assessments.

name: Personal Lines Underwriter
description: Owns personal lines risk selection within the Underwriting value stream, quoting, negotiating, and binding policies through the policy administration system and underwriting workstation. Processes mid-term endorsements, administers reinsurance treaty referrals and bordereaux, monitors portfolio concentration and appetite exceptions, and reports appetite status to the underwriting committee.

name: Platform Engineering Lead
description: Leads cloud and platform engineering within the Technology & Engineering value stream, with additional responsibility for Data & AI pipeline reliability. Owns the observability platform, alert intake and triage, IT service request fulfillment, and resilience improvement, including self-healing automation, hypercare and post-release support, and recovery verification via smoke tests.

name: Policy Admin Ops Lead
description: Leads policy operations within the Corporate Operations value stream, owning workforce capacity planning, vendor service management, and process improvement. Monitors real-time workload against staffing, manages vendor performance reviews and remediation plans, assesses regulatory change impact on operations, and produces operations performance reporting including cost-per-transaction analysis.

name: Policy Administration Analyst
description: Performs policy administration across the Business Operations value stream, covering policy issuance, renewals, cancellations, and term conversion processing. Conducts annuity good-order and suitability reviews, runs plan installation and nondiscrimination testing with corrective distributions, reconciles subaccount unit values, resolves beneficiary designation conflicts, and responds to auditor requests.

name: Policy Administrator
description: Administers policy operations within the Corporate Operations value stream, supporting workforce capacity planning and vendor service management. Monitors workload against staffing, triggers load-balancing for queue imbalances, tracks vendor remediation plans and SOC 2 certifications, forecasts transaction volumes, and supports regulatory change operations and performance reporting.

name: Policy Data Entry Clerk
description: Performs policy data entry and transaction processing within the Corporate Operations value stream's Policy Operations function. Supports operations performance reporting and process improvement by maintaining accurate records, monitoring workload queues, and tracking transaction volumes that feed workforce capacity planning and vendor service management.

name: Policy Forms Specialist
description: Drafts and maintains policy forms within the Product & Delivery value stream, supporting coverage design, filing preparation, and regulatory approval management. Runs state-by-state compliance pre-checks, reconciles filed rate pages against the rating algorithm, completes QA reviews of filing packages, and supports underwriting guideline design and product launch execution.

name: Policy Issuance Specialist
description: Processes policy issuance work within the Corporate Operations value stream's Policy Operations function. Supports workforce capacity planning and process improvement by monitoring workload against staffing, tracking transaction volumes, escalating vendor performance failures, and contributing to regulatory change operations and operations performance reporting.

name: Portfolio Analyst
description: Coordinates investment prioritization and initiative intake within the Program Management Office value stream. Logs and assesses initiative requests for strategic fit, routes qualified demand to the intake committee, investigates budget variance root causes for in-year reallocation, identifies capacity gaps, and assembles governance committee decision packs while tracking open actions to closure.
